feeds.description: Depths measured by ordinary boats' echo sounders and shared through the IHO crowdsourced bathymetry programme, rebuilt weekly. Not corrected for tide. Blank water has no soundings: treat it as unknown, never as deep.
feeds.provider: IHO Data Centre for Digital Bathymetry (crowdsourced bathymetry)
